\newcommand{\cvTavanaBullets}{%
  \item[] \href{\cvTavanaUrl}{\textbf{tavanastore.ir}} \textit{-- e-commerce platform (Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) with \textbf{20,000+ daily users}.}
  \item Took the Lighthouse performance score \textbf{from 62 to 91} with SSR/SSG on key pages, bundle splitting and image optimization.

  \item Set up Sentry with alerts. We fixed production bugs \textbf{about 40\% faster} after that.
  \item Added lint, type-check and build checks to CI for every pull request, plus a preview deploy per PR for design and QA to review.%
